product_overview: Pulse is a browser-based creator workflow app for managing content ideas, drafts, scheduling, and LinkedIn connection setup. It includes a marketing site plus an authenticated workspace with navigation, content management, scheduling, and settings pages.
core_goals: Discover the product and move into account creation or sign-in from the marketing site.
Create an account or sign in with email and password.
Access the authenticated app shell and navigate between core workspace areas.
Review and manage content ideas and drafts.
Configure post scheduling and inspect the queue.
Connect and manage a LinkedIn account from settings.

features.name: Landing page navigation
features.description: Let visitors explore the marketing site and move into authentication entry points.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll through the hero and feature sections -> Use in-page navigation links -> Open sign-in or sign-up from a marketing call to action

features.name: Sign in
features.description: Allow returning users to authenticate with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit the form -> See the authenticated experience
Navigate to /sign-in -> Leave required fields blank or enter an invalid email format -> Submit the form -> See field-level validation feedback
Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter credentials -> Submit the form -> Observe a clear error message when the credentials are rejected

features.name: Sign up
features.description: Allow new users to register an account with email and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-up -> Complete the registration fields -> Submit the form -> See the authenticated experience or first-run destination
Navigate to /sign-up -> Enter mismatched passwords or weak password input -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback on the form
Navigate to /sign-up -> Enter an invalid email format -> Submit the form -> See field-level error feedback

features.name: Protected app shell and routing
features.description: Provide the authenticated workspace and let users move between the main app sections.
user_flows: Navigate to /app after authentication -> See the dashboard home in the authenticated layout -> Use app navigation to open content, schedule, and settings sections
Navigate to /app/content after authentication -> See the content workspace within the protected shell
Navigate to /app/schedule after authentication -> See the scheduling workspace within the protected shell
Navigate to /app/settings after authentication -> See the settings hub within the protected shell
Navigate to /app/settings/preferences after authentication -> See the detailed preferences form
Navigate to /app/settings/connections after authentication -> See the LinkedIn connection management page
Navigate to /app/preferences after authentication -> See the creator preferences shortcut page
Navigate to /app while signed out -> See a redirect to sign-in or an equivalent authentication gate

features.name: Content workspace
features.description: Let authenticated users review topic ideas and draft content.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/content after authentication -> View the content board -> Open a draft or interact with draft elements -> Review the draft workspace
Navigate to /app/content after authentication -> View an empty or first-run state -> Follow the guidance to begin working with content drafts

features.name: Schedule posts
features.description: Let authenticated users review the queue and interact with the post composer and schedule controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/schedule after authentication -> Review the queue board -> Interact with the composer or visible configuration controls -> See the scheduling workspace update
Navigate to /app/schedule after authentication -> Review the scheduling queue -> Open or adjust visible scheduling inputs -> See the queue or preview reflect the changes
Navigate to /app/schedule after authentication -> Enter an invalid schedule value such as a past time or missing required content -> Submit the form -> See readable validation feedback

features.name: LinkedIn connections
features.description: Let authenticated users view and manage LinkedIn connection status from settings.
user_flows: Navigate to /app/settings/connections after authentication -> Review the connection status -> Start the connect flow when available -> Reach the provider consent flow and return to the app
Navigate to /app/settings/connections after authentication -> Review the connection status -> See guidance to reconnect when the account is disconnected or expired
